title: Figure 23. First Generation (MAYA I) DNA-based Logic Circuit that plays tic-tac-toe
description: Illustrated infographic showing a 3×3 array of wells numbered 1–9 containing colored DNA logic gates, with sidebars titled "MAYA-I's Structure" and "Example Game." A sequence of panels below shows a human player named Harry adding input strands by pipette and the automaton's responding moves on small tic-tac-toe boards. Captioned "Figure 23. First Generation (MAYA I) DNA-based Logic Circuit that plays tic-tac-toe."
